title: Idiots in the reviews
body: To all the people saying 'I paid for this app years ago and now they want to charge me a subscription' — if you purchased the app years ago you're grandfathered in. You get the app completely free. You need to sign into the original email or Apple ID that you used when you purchased. It took me all of two minutes to figure this out.

title: Ready to stop the excuses?
body: This program is focused on teaching you to be mentally strong, stop making excuses, and turn your 'I'll try' into I CAN and I WILL! If you follow it, you will see changes in many areas of your life! The physical changes just happen to be an awesome bonus, but the point of this program is to change your way of thinking.

title: Review the APP, not the program.
body: The 75 Hard program is life changing and I've achieved amazing results. With all of that being said, the app is boloney especially for those who struggle with keeping track of their daily progress. I have to use multiple other apps to use this app and the app doesn't cross connect to other apps making it a pain. #1 big complaint, there is no water tracker or widget which everyone needs. The photo upload is a joke as well. It's not worth the $5. If you're going to charge, do better and offer a proper app.

title: This is a great challenge/experience
body: This program is great! I'm only on day 7 but I can already see how everyday you complete is another day that you've won. I'm finding myself pushing myself harder in these tasks. One of my exercises I do daily is taking a walk and every day I try to go further. Now on day 49.

title: Exactly what you need to succeed
body: This is the perfect app to go along with the program, it gives you reminders (without coddling you) for all the steps, a place to add your pictures and a place to add notes. If you forget to track something there is a prompt to check in versus just an automatic fail. And if you started the program without the app, you can start on whatever day you were on.

title: 7 Days In - Going Strong
body: Love the accountability this app provides. Super simplistic concept but with seamless integration into camera and reminders app makes it easy to stay on track. I was late crossing off my tasks after a busy day and I even liked the added touch of Andy standing there asking if you 'really' completed the job. My one observation is how valuable a tool this would also be for the power list. I am still doing my best at using a power list in addition to my 75 hard tasks.

title: Review
body: I love the app- checking off each task as I finish it has definitely encouraged me to perform the tasks- it's like a mini high five to myself for completing a goal. I love the option of daily reminders for specific challenges (taking a daily photo reminder was necessary). My issues with the app: 1- more space to write in the journal, 2- option to look at daily photo before the day is over (sometimes I want to retake my photo because I can't remember what photo I took at 7am).

title: Future improvements
body: I love this app and what it's about. I love taking notes and the daily pictures and the accountability factor. My one issue is I failed on day 4 and I typed start over to start at day 1. But now I can not see any of my previous notes or pictures and I don't like that. I write a lot of things down in the notes and for them to just disappear because I start over is not okay. What's the point of the notes feature if they are going to just get deleted?

title: Love it!!!
body: In the initial Podcast that Andy created for this, he emphasizes how this is on an honor system and there's no accountability. A lot of people seek accountability partners but the app is perfect in helping you check off what you did and have that affirmation that you did it (a checklist) but still keep the focus on doing it yourself. In life, after setbacks I struggle with not trusting myself anymore and then seeking affirmation in others.

title: Awesome app tracker for 75 hard
body: Awesome app to track your progress for 75 day hard challenge. Only recommendation for the app is to add in more pictures for our progress pics and to input in more notes. Maybe have a section for our small notes so when we click on the photo that will appear. Also would be cool to have a time lapse vid in the end with our progress pics. Also for those that's complaining about the price, I say it's really not bad cause it keeps us accountable.
